notes: Index-linked USD annuity, reference index S&P 500. 上限率 (cap) and 参照運用利回り (reference yield) are set per 運用対象期間 of 1 year; the first period's values are fixed on the contract date (1st of the month after the company's responsibility starts), later ones on each annual anniversary. effective_date is the 契約応当日 shown on the page; term_years is blank (annual period). The page says 上限率 is set from the 参照運用利回り after deducting 0.5% (contract maintenance, deferral and payout) and 0.1% (surrender value, deferral).

The page's 参照指数が運用対象期間で上昇・下落した率 (index return) and 積立金上昇率 columns are populated only after the period ends (one year after the anniversary); every row visible on 2026-11-17 was blank, so no participation or fund-growth figures are stored. No participation rate is published; the product is cap-only. They would appear in later snapshots, and the 上限率・積立金上昇率（ご契約者さま） page (01-2.html) is a year/month search form that was not submitted.

The page shows only 2026 anniversaries (2026-01-01 to 2026-11-01, 11 rows) under 直近のご契約に適用された上限率; its year selector offers only 2026. No history before 2026-01 is on the site. Monthly series, so a later run on a saved snapshot adds the 2026-12-01 value, etc.

The rate fragment (/hpcms/Fxrate2000.do) refuses scripts (bot protection); the table was read in the built-in browser pane on 2026-11-17 and saved to sources/pgf/pages/sdia_limit_rate_2026-11-17.html (the rendered table). scripts/pgf.py parses it and does not bypass the protection.
Reference index page (sdia/02.html) shows S&P 500 on 2026-11-16 at 7,416.59 and a historical-index search; index levels are not collected (licensed data, redistribution restricted by the page).
Capture dates: current page footer PGF-J-2025-424 (2025.12.1); product page footer PGF-J-2025-417 (2025.12.1).

guarantee_terms_years is null: the deferral period (据置期間) and any guarantee term were not established. The 1-year figure the collector first recorded here is the 運用対象期間 over which each cap applies, not a guarantee term. Checked 2026-11-17 by an independent agent: all 22 points match the snapshot and the live page; edition names (full-width ＵＳ as on the page), policy name and cost deductions are saved as page text in sources/pgf/pages/pagetext_sdia_01-1_2026-11-17.txt, which also records the S&P 500® reference index from sdia/02.html.

Documents (2026-11-17): the product page's 契約概要／注意喚起情報 tab and Web約款 link are filled from the insurer's public JSON (/assets/json/product/onsale/detail-list.json, entry id 45, and /assets/json/weby/detail-list.json, web_id 2811), saved under sources/pgf/pages/. They give the 契約概要／注意喚起情報 PDF /st/products/sdia/general2/pdf/01.pdf (agencies 静岡銀行・名古屋銀行・山梨中央銀行; product number PGF-J-2026-152（2026.4.1）) and the Web約款 page /weby/2811.html (contracts from 2026/04/01, PGF-J-2026-118（2026.4.1）; the April 2026 edition is taken from that list, the document itself was not seen). Both answered a single plain request with the site's bot-protection page ('Pardon Our Interruption'), not the document; not worked around. The Wayback Machine has no capture of either URL (CDX checked 2026-11-17). No brochure PDF is listed: the JSON gives only a thumbnail image (pamphlet1_url). The sibling edition そだてる年金ＵＳ＜一時払＞ has its own 契約概要 PDF (/st/products/sdia/general/pdf/01.pdf, not fetched) and shares Web約款 2811.
has_mva is null: not established (the 契約概要／注意喚起情報 PDF was downloaded 2026-11-17 but not read for surrender rules). on_sale_date is null: no insurer release or page gives a launch date.

Distributors: 静岡銀行, 名古屋銀行, 山梨中央銀行, from the agency list of entry id 45 (そだてる果実＜一時払＞) in the insurer's published product JSON (sources/pgf/pages/onsale_detail-list_2026-11-17.json, retrieved 2026-11-17), which matches the 販売代理店 section of the product page. Documents: the 契約概要／注意喚起情報 PDF was downloaded 2026-11-17 (the earlier refusal no longer occurs); the Web約款 link is an HTML page, not a PDF.

Launch date check 2026-11-17: 山梨中央銀行's notice of 2026-01-30 gives 「１．取扱開始日 2月2日（月）」 (2026-02-02, snapshot sources/pgf/pages/release_pgf-sodateru-kajitsu_20260130_yamanashibank_2026-11-17.pdf). That is one bank's start, not the product's: the cap and reference-yield series on file already have a 2026-01-01 row, 静岡銀行 and 名古屋銀行 also sell it, and the same form is sold as そだてる年金ＵＳ＜一時払＞. Not adopted as on_sale_date.
notes_en: Index-linked USD annuity tracking the S&P 500, with an annual cap rate; no participation rate is published.
Only 2026 history is available, with eleven monthly values from January to November 2026.
Index returns and fund growth figures are blank until a year after each anniversary, so none are held; index levels are not collected.

The contract summary and web policy conditions are listed with their links but were not downloaded, because the insurer's site blocked the request and no archived copy exists; no brochure PDF is published online.
Launch date and guarantee period are not established, and the market value adjustment terms have not been read.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:pgf-sodateru-kajitsu; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
